title: Belgrade Camera Registry
description: A registry of live traffic/webcam feeds in Belgrade, used as the input source for TrafficAnalyzer's congestion, incident, and traffic-counting analysis.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this camera (e.g. a slug).

name.description: Human-readable name of the camera or the location it covers.

location.description: Where in Belgrade this camera is located.

resolution.description: Last-known stream resolution, e.g. '1920x1080'. Null if not yet determined.

source.description: Provider/publisher of the feed, e.g. 'Belgrade Traffic Authority' or 'Windy.com'.

url.description: The stream URL used to probe/consume this camera's live video.

protocol.description: Delivery protocol of the stream. HLS is included alongside RTSP/HTTP/MJPEG since it is a common HTTP-delivered live-streaming format.

status.description: Whether the camera was confirmed working as of lastVerifiedAt.

lastVerifiedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last automated validation run. Null if never validated by the CLI.

lastError.description: Reason the last validation attempt failed, if status is 'inactive'.

headers.description: Extra HTTP request headers required to fetch 'url' (e.g. a Referer some providers require to defeat hotlink protection).

alternateUrl.description: Optional backup stream URL covering the same location, used as a fallback if 'url' fails to load.

alternateSource.description: Provider/publisher of 'alternateUrl', e.g. 'Informer.rs (Srbija na dlanu network)'.

alternateHeaders.description: Extra HTTP request headers required to fetch 'alternateUrl', mirroring 'headers' for the primary url.
